A natural talent, Quando Rondo was once a small child, secretly singing in the bathroom as a 9-year-old boy in Savannah, GA. His natural gravitation towards music lead to him to hip-hop; he began recording his fledgling verses on his cell phone. He quickly gained traction online, racking up millions of views on YouTube.

Fittingly, he titled his 2018 mixtape 'Life B4 Fame' with the hopes that things would change for the better once his career really took off. He was right—within two days, his mixtape had amassed more than one million streams on MyMixtapez. Things will only go up from there, and if the snippets from his forthcoming Rich Homie Quando project are any sign, he’s only only getting better with time.

#QuandoRondo #Recovery #

snippet.title: THE NIGHTINGALE – Official Teaser Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
In love we find out who we want to be. In war we find out who we are.

Based on Kristin Hannah’s global best-selling phenomenon, Elle and Dakota Fanning star in #TheNightingaleMovie — exclusively in theatres this March.

Based on Kristin Hannah’s global book phenomenon — one of the bestselling novels of our time — The Nightingale stars real-life sisters Elle and Dakota Fanning together onscreen for the first time in the powerful, emotional story of two sisters forced to embark on separate courageous, dangerous paths in a fight for survival and freedom during World War II.

Directed by:​​
Michael Morris​​​
​
Screenplay by:​​​
Dana Stevens and Ann Peacock
 
Based on the book by:​​
Kristin Hannah​
 
Produced by:​​​​
Dakota Fanning
Elle Fanning
​​​​​Brittany Kahan Ward
​​​​​Reese Witherspoon
​​​​​Lauren Neustadter
Elizabeth Cantillon
 
Executive Producers: ​​​
Emily Ferenbach
​​​​​J. Michael Williams
​​​​​Kristin Hannah
 
Cast:
​Elle Fanning
​Dakota Fanning
​Edmund Donovan
​Albrecht Schuch
​Shira Haas
​and Mark Rylance
 
Credits not final
 
This film is not yet rated by The Motion Picture Association. For future rating information, please visit www.filmratings.com.

snippet.title: LITTLEFOOT | Official Trailer | Land Before Time Reimagining
snippet.description:
TODAY, WE GET TO SHARE SOMETHING TRULY SPECIAL.

Three years of hard work. Countless setbacks. More challenges than I can possibly put into words. And now, after a journey that first began back in 2017, we finally get to show the world what we've been working on and what better day to do it than the 38th anniversary of THE LAND BEFORE TIME. The film that inspired so many of us, and the reason this little dinosaur means so much to so many people.

We've brought together an incredible team of artists, animators, musicians, filmmakers and voice actors from around the world. Every single person has given their time, talent and passion to make this happen, simply because they believe in this story.

To our cast, hearing these characters come to life through voices I've grown up listening to has been one of the most surreal experiences of my life.

To our crew, what you've managed to achieve, often against impossible odds, is nothing short of extraordinary.

This isn't just a film about a little dinosaur. It's a love letter to the stories that stay with us, the people who bring them to life, and what can happen when a group of people refuse to give up on a dream.

So today, on the anniversary of the film that started it all, we're incredibly proud to finally share this with you.

localized.title: LITTLEFOOT | Official Trailer | Land Before Time Reimagining
localized.description:
TODAY, WE GET TO SHARE SOMETHING TRULY SPECIAL.

Three years of hard work. Countless setbacks. More challenges than I can possibly put into words. And now, after a journey that first began back in 2017, we finally get to show the world what we've been working on and what better day to do it than the 38th anniversary of THE LAND BEFORE TIME. The film that inspired so many of us, and the reason this little dinosaur means so much to so many people.

We've brought together an incredible team of artists, animators, musicians, filmmakers and voice actors from around the world. Every single person has given their time, talent and passion to make this happen, simply because they believe in this story.

To our cast, hearing these characters come to life through voices I've grown up listening to has been one of the most surreal experiences of my life.

To our crew, what you've managed to achieve, often against impossible odds, is nothing short of extraordinary.

This isn't just a film about a little dinosaur. It's a love letter to the stories that stay with us, the people who bring them to life, and what can happen when a group of people refuse to give up on a dream.

So today, on the anniversary of the film that started it all, we're incredibly proud to finally share this with you.

snippet.title: The Beatles - In My Life (Official Music Video starring Owen Cooper)
snippet.description:
Directed by Jessica Swale and Irina Alexiu
 
Watch the official video for The Beatles' 'In My Life’, written and directed by 2 x Olivier Award winner Jessica Swale and Irina Alexiu and featuring Emmy, BAFTA and Golden Globe winner, Owen Cooper.
 
A love letter to The Beatles' hometown, Liverpool, the film follows the journey of a treasured ukulele as it sparks a relationship, creates an enduring bond between mother and son, and inspires a love of music that passes through a family over the decades.
 
‘In My Life’ is from the Beatles' sixth album, Rubber Soul, originally released on December 3rd, 1965.

snippet.title: The Comeback King | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Fall hard. Come back stronger. 
Watch The Comeback King trailer now. 

Pre-save The Comeback King - Soundtrack: https://comebackking.ffm.to/soundtrack
Featuring original songs sung by Glen Powell and Madelyn Cline. 
-----
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@thecomebackkingmovie
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thecomebackkingmovie
X: https://twitter.com/_comebackking_
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thecomebackkingmovie
Official Site: https://thecomebackkingmovie.com

Judd Apatow and Glen Powell partner to write a new original comedy directed by Apatow, a film that joins Apatow’s lineage of defining comedy classics, including The 40-Year-Old Virgin, Knocked Up and Trainwreck. The Comeback King charts the rise, crash and comeback of a country music star who checks out, grows up and learns a little along the way.

Powell, star of Hit Man, Twisters and Top Gun: Maverick, trained in guitar and singing to perform a number of songs penned by some of Nashville’s foremost songwriters in this love letter to country music.

The Comeback King stars Powell as Aubrey King, a hot-shot country sensation whose songs about drinkin’ and lovin’ are fueling his rise but are leaving him feeling like a commodity, exacerbated by the fact that he’s dating the world’s biggest pop superstar, Missy (Madelyn Cline; Outer Banks, Glass Onion). 

After Aubrey discovers that he is not Missy’s one-and-only and breaks up with her, an irate Missy goes on offense and releases a track that makes Aubrey the cheater, sending his life and career into a rapid downward spiral. 

Faced with a mandatory timeout, Aubrey dodges the spotlight and returns to college to finally finish his degree and discover what he wants to say in his music, sparked by Sam, a no-nonsense professor (Emmy winner Cristin Milioti; The Penguin, The Resort) who is initially unimpressed by the celebrity crashing in her classroom. 

The film’s top-flight comedic cast includes Stavros Halkias (Tires, Bugonia) as Aubrey’s unconventional manager and breakout Li Jin Hao (Mitchell and Webb Are Not Helping, Tomorrow is a Long Time) as Jeff, Aubrey’s sweet roommate whose quiet demeanor hides virtuosic surprises. 

The all-star supporting cast includes stand-up phenom Leanne Morgan (Leanne), Oscar® nominee Kumail Nanjiani (The Big Sick), Emmy nominee Vanessa Bayer (SNL), Atsuko Okatsuka (Father), Oscar® and Emmy nominee Tig Notaro (Star Trek: Starfleet Academy), Emmy nominee Chris Fleming (Chris Fleming: Live from the Palace), Emmy nominee Mike Birbiglia (Trainwreck) and Big Fella (Cookin’ Wit’ Big Fella). 

The Comeback King also features appearances by a cavalcade of country music superstars including Jelly Roll, Brad Paisley, Miranda Lambert, Shaboozey, Chris Stapleton, Brandi Carlile, Luke Bryan and Reba McEntire. 

Written by three-time Emmy winner and Golden Globe nominee Judd Apatow and by SAG Award-winner and two-time Golden Globe nominee Glen Powell, The Comeback King is directed by Apatow and produced by Kevin Misher (Coming 2 America, Richard Jewell), Apatow, Powell and four-time Emmy nominee Dan Cohen (Backrooms, Stranger Things). The executive producers are Barry Mendel and Josh Church.

snippet.title: GTA 6 ULTIMATE BEGINNERS GUIDE! 32 Tips You NEED to Know (Don't Make These Mistakes)
snippet.description:
GTA 6 BEGINNERS GUIDE: GTA 6 Tips & Tricks You NEED To Know!
►If you enjoyed the video, please consider hitting 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe for more!
►https://youtu.be/iO_WVL3jVx8?si=1z7Hc-tLejTa4008

The ULTIMATE GTA 6 beginners guide: 33 GTA 6 tips and tricks I wish I knew before I started playing. After 10+ hours in Leonida on PS5 Pro, here's everything you need to know to protect your money, build up Jason and Lucia, lose the cops, and get the best possible start in Grand Theft Auto VI. Every tip is checked in my own game, and there are no story spoilers.

💰 MONEY Cash in your pocket is gone when you die or get busted. Hide it under the floorboards in Jason's bedroom, then bank it at an ATM once the bank unlocks in the mission Buck Me. Loot bags are lost on death too, but guns you've bought come back. Loot enemies you take down for cash, ammo and weapons.

💪 GYM, FOOD & FOCUS Work out 3 days in a row to build strength and Focus. Weights build strength and health, cardio builds stamina, and eating at home gives you a buff. Click both sticks for Focus to see enemies through walls, safe codes and alarmed doors. Petting animals and helping neighbours fill your Focus back up.

🚓 THE POLICE Cops aren't on your minimap anymore. They find you through witnesses and cameras, so change your car colour, your look and your outfit to get away. Register stolen cars, and watch out for cars with trackers.

🚗 CARS Scan cars with the WAiNK app before stealing them, get free repairs at Joey's, watch your fuel, use Paradise Taxi to fast travel, use the car controls for windows, headlights and hazards, and shove your car back over if you flip it.

🗺️ EXPLORING The full map starts hidden under fog. Walk, drive or fly over each area to reveal it, and check the Exploration tab for neighbour favours. Sleep to skip time, and repair your house.

🎯 FIRST PERSON There's no first-person mode, but certain gun attachments let you aim in first person.

👩 PLAYING AS LUCIA You first play as Lucia in Day Release at the end of Chapter 1, but you can't swap freely between her and Jason until Chapter 2. Then hold Right on the D-pad to switch.

💬 Which tip didn't you know? Tell me in the comments, and share your own tips for other new players. 🔔 SUBSCRIBE for more GTA 6 guides, secrets, cheat codes and map locations.

snippet.title: GTA 6 Feels Like a Full Time Job...
snippet.description:
GTA 6 has a 99 on Metacritic, but the opening hours have you fixing roofs, chasing rent, unblocking sinks and fetching your neighbour’s rum. Even The Sims made fun of it. So why did Rockstar make the most expensive game ever feel like a shift at work? I went through what the biggest streamers, reviewers and players are saying, why Red Dead’s chores worked and GTA 6’s don’t, and whether it actually gets better.

Is GTA 6 the most immersive game Rockstar has ever made, or does it genuinely feel like a full time job? If you’ve made it past chapter one, tell me in the comments if it got better.

snippet.title: Christmas AI Short - Christmas With Myself - Kelly Boesch | 4K
snippet.description:
Many years ago, I spent Christmas entirely alone in Los Angeles. Everyone I knew was either out of town or had other plans, so I ended up spending the whole day by myself.

I remember listening to Christmas music, making myself dinner, and feeling a little sorry for myself. But as the day went on, I started to feel kind of okay with it. I actually began to enjoy having the day to myself. It was an interesting experience, and one I've never forgotten.

I know there are many people who spend Christmas alone, some by choice and others not. I wanted to write a song about that Christmas because I think I learned something about myself that day.

It's not meant to be a sad song. It's really about learning to be comfortable with yourself and realizing that sometimes things don't have to turn out the way you expected to still be good.

I wouldn't want to spend every Christmas alone, but looking back, I'm glad I had that one. ❤️

Christmas With Myself
 
[Verse 1]
I woke up late on Christmas Day
With nowhere I was meant to be
No presents waiting by the door
No one expecting much from me
 
I made some coffee, took my time
And watched the morning come and go
The world was busy being merry
I had a day to call my own
 
[Chorus]
So here's to Christmas with myself
A little different than before
I thought I'd miss a thousand things
But didn't miss them anymore
 
And somewhere in the quiet hours
With nothing special I should do
I spent a Christmas all alone
And met somebody I once knew
 
[Verse 2]
I played the songs I used to love
And sang the parts I still remembered
I made a dinner just for one
And let the day unfold unmeasured
 
I thought about the years gone by
The people here and those I'd lost
And how a day can still be lovely
Even missing snow and frost
 
[Chorus]
So here's to Christmas with myself
A little different than before
I thought I'd miss a thousand things
But didn't miss them anymore
 
And somewhere in the quiet hours
With nothing special I should do
I spent a Christmas all alone
And met somebody I once knew
 
[Bridge]
I didn't learn the meaning of life
Or suddenly become someone new
I just got a little closer
To the person I already knew
 
[Final Chorus]
So here's to Christmas with myself
And all the things I came to see
Sometimes the greatest gift you get
Is being good company
 
I wouldn't wish for every Christmas
To be as quiet as that day
But I'm glad I had that one alone
I wouldn't give that one away

snippet.description:
GTA VI: 5 Things You Should Do Right When You Start
https://youtu.be/x5TIARqO-rE

Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following Grand Theft Auto V (2013), and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.

Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.

Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 17 million digital copies, generating over $1.6 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. It tied The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) to become the highest-rated video game on Metacritic[a], and it is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99

-----------------------------------------------------------------
Grand Theft Auto VI is a 2026 action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, and in the fictional city of Vice City, based on Miami, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players are able to freely roam Leonida's open world.

Preliminary work began in 2014 following the release of Grand Theft Auto V, with principal production starting after the launch of Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018. Rockstar's global development teams more than doubled since Red Dead Redemption 2. Miami and its surrounding areas were extensively researched for the game's world, which parodies 2020s American culture. The protagonists' dynamic is inspired by the notorious outlaw duo Bonnie and Clyde, and the non-player characters (NPCs) were written to ensure players experience different areas of Vice City.

Following years of speculation and anticipation, Rockstar confirmed in February 2022 that the game was in development. That September, footage from unfinished versions was leaked. Grand Theft Auto VI was formally revealed in December 2023. It became the most preordered video game of all time, with estimated sales exceeding 19 million digital copies, generating over US$1.8 billion in revenue prior to launch. Following two delays, further leaks, and an extensive marketing campaign, it was released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S to universal critical acclaim. It tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) as the highest-rated video game on Metacritic, and it is the only game from the 21st century to achieve an overall score of 99.
~ Wikipedia
